children.text: Greeting & Basic Information
children.cn: 问候与基本信息

children.text: Hello, everyone!
children.cn: 大家好！
children.notes: everyone = 每个人，作主语时谓语动词用单数。
children.statement: Hello, everyone! 适合作为自我介绍征文的开篇问候。
children.explanation: Hello, everyone! 表达友好亲切的打招呼，用于吸引读者。

children.text: My name is Li Hua and I am twelve years old.
children.cn: 我的名字叫李华，我今年十二岁。
children.statement: 本句介绍了作者的姓名和年龄。
children.explanation: 介绍姓名和年龄是初中自我介绍的基础句型。

children.text: I am in Class 1, Grade 7 in our school.
children.cn: 我在我们学校七年级一班。
children.notes: Class 1, Grade 7 = 七年级一班（班级、年级首字母均需大写）。
children.statement: 英文中表示“在几班几年级”时，先说班级后说年级。
children.explanation: 英语表达中从小单位到大单位，Class 1 在 Grade 7 前面。

children.text: School Things & Hobbies
children.cn: 学习用品与爱好

children.text: I have a blue schoolbag with many books and pencils.
children.cn: 我有一个装有许多书和铅笔的蓝色书包。
children.notes: with = 带有；many + 可数名词复数
children.statement: 句中的 "with" 表示伴随或含有。
children.explanation: with many books and pencils 作后置定语修饰 schoolbag。

children.text: My favourite colour is blue because it is clean and nice.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，因为它干净又漂亮。
children.notes: favourite = 最喜爱的；because 引导原因状语从句。
children.statement: 句中的 "because" 用于解释喜欢蓝色的原因。
children.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句，连接从句说明缘由。

children.text: I like playing basketball with my friends after school.
children.cn: 我喜欢放学后和我的朋友们打篮球。
children.notes: like doing sth. = 喜欢做某事；play basketball = 打篮球
children.statement: play basketball 中球类名词前不加冠词 the。
children.explanation: 球类运动前不用冠词，play basketball 表达正确。

children.text: Personality & Invitation
children.cn: 性格与交友邀请

children.text: I am very kind and I want to make new friends here.
children.cn: 我非常友善，我想在这里结交新朋友。
children.notes: kind = 善良的，友好的；make friends = 结交朋友
children.statement: make friends 是固定短语，意为“交朋友”。
children.explanation: make friends 是七年级核心短语，friends 用复数形式。

children.text: Do you want to be my friend?
children.cn: 你想成为我的朋友吗？
children.notes: want to do sth. = 想要做某事；be one's friend = 做某人的朋友
children.statement: 这是一个以助动词 Do 开头的一般疑问句。
children.explanation: 一般疑问句用于征询对方意愿，亲切友好。

children.text: Warm Greeting & Profile
children.cn: 热情问候与个人概况

children.text: Hello, everyone!
children.cn: 大家好！
children.notes: everyone = 每个人，作主语时谓语动词用单数。
children.statement: Hello, everyone! 适合作为开篇问候。
children.explanation: 热情亲切的问候语能够迅速拉近与读者的距离。

children.text: My name is Li Hua and I am a 12-year-old student in Class 1, Grade 7.
children.cn: 我的名字叫李华，是七年级一班一名12岁的学生。
children.notes: 12-year-old = 复合形容词“12岁的”，修饰 student。
children.statement: 12-year-old 是复合形容词，其中的 year 必须用单数形式。
children.explanation: 数词-名词-形容词构成的复合形容词中，名词用单数。

children.text: I am very excited to study in our new middle school.
children.cn: 能在我们新的中学学习，我感到非常兴奋。
children.notes: be excited to do sth. = 做某事感到兴奋
children.statement: excited 用于修饰人的感受，意为“感到兴奋的”。
children.explanation: excited 常以人作主语，表示内心的激动与兴奋。

children.text: Schoolbag & Interests
children.cn: 学习用品与课外兴趣

children.text: Look at my blue schoolbag, which is full of interesting books and neat stationery.
children.cn: 看我的蓝色书包，里面装满了有趣的书籍和整洁的文具。
children.notes: be full of = 装满……；stationery = 文具（不可数名词）
children.statement: which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明 schoolbag。
children.explanation: which 引导定语从句，使句型更加丰富高级。
children.keywords: blue schoolbag, full of, books, stationery

children.text: Besides, my favourite colour is blue because it represents peace and wisdom.
children.cn: 此外，我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，因为它象征着和平与智慧。
children.notes: Besides = 此外（副词过渡词）；represent = 代表，象征
children.statement: Besides 在句首起承上启下的递进过渡作用。
children.explanation: Besides 常用作副词连接上下文，后通常加逗号。

children.text: In my free time, I often play basketball with my classmates to keep fit.
children.cn: 在空闲时间，我经常和同学们打篮球来保持健康。
children.notes: in one's free time = 在空闲时间；to keep fit = 动词不定式作目的状语（为了保持健康）
children.statement: to keep fit 在句中作目的状语。
children.explanation: 动词不定式 to keep fit 表达打篮球的目的。
children.keywords: free time, play basketball, keep fit

children.text: Character & Friendly Call
children.cn: 优良品质与真诚邀请

children.text: I am always kind and helpful, so I look forward to making friends with all of you.
children.cn: 我总是热情善良乐于助人，因此我非常期待与大家所有人成为朋友。
children.notes: helpful = 乐于助人的；look forward to doing sth. = 期待做某事（to为介词，后接动名词）
children.statement: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 making。
children.explanation: look forward to doing sth. 是固定高频短语，to 为介词。
children.keywords: kind, helpful, look forward to, making friends

children.text: If you want to know more about me, please come and talk to me!
children.cn: 如果你想更多地了解我，请来和我交流吧！
children.notes: If 引导条件状语从句；talk to sb. = 和某人交谈
children.statement: If 引导条件状语从句，主句为祈使句。
children.explanation: If 引导的从句与祈使句主句配合，发出诚挚的交友邀请。
children.keywords: If, know more, talk to me
